claim: Price Class 100 includes only the edge locations in the United States, Mexico and Canada and in Europe, Israel and Türkiye; the other price-class regions are not included.
question: Which edge location regions does CloudFront Price Class 100 include?

values.display: United States, Mexico and Canada and in Europe, Israel and Türkiye
